# now-playing

<!-- AUTOGENERATED:BEGIN — do not edit; regenerated by `./equin build` -->

## Plugin reference

- Description: A Sonata player's song in the browser's media session (media/media-session): Chrome's media controls and the OS's Now Playing / media keys show its name (a library song's live title, a file's name — from the song document) with the Sonata icon, a scrubber over the tempo-scaled song, and play / pause / seek driving the playback session. A SonataSession.Effect, so every player claims it — the Sonata app's (following its song when it plays on with no Sonata page shown; Sonata's background music source leaves the session to it), a file preview's and a mini player's — and the one that started playing last owns the session.
- Web:
  - Contributes: `SonataSession.Effect` "now-playing" → `SonataNowPlaying`
  - Uses:
    - `apps/sonata/document.SongIdentity`
    - `apps/sonata/document.useSongDocument`
    - `apps/sonata/session.SonataSession`
    - `apps/sonata/session.useCursorApi`
    - `apps/sonata/session.useSession`
    - `media/media-session.useMediaSession`
    - `network/live.rowOrStale`
    - `network/live.useLive`
